question: Posts streams in after its fallback was sent. How does its HTML replace the fallback?
options: An inline <script> sent with the new HTML swaps it in
The client fetches Posts after hydration
The server holds the page until Posts is done
say: Posts streams in after its fallback was sent. How does its HTML replace the fallback?
explanation: React sends the remaining HTML along with an inline script tag that replaces the fallback. This works before React itself loads in the browser.
explainSay: React sends the new HTML with a small inline script that swaps it in, even before React loads.
